parent_objective: run the no-training public-base promotion/generalization gate for M1362 alpha 0.1
blocked_by: M1368 defines the gate criteria; M1362 alpha 0.1 has broad public replay evidence but no fresh generalization gate
supersedes: private holdout before public promotion gate
candidate-b hardcoded promotion gate reuse without generic labels

public_gates: M1369 must keep actor inputs unchanged
M1369 must evaluate exact source-history retention
M1369 must run six public proof replay surfaces or consume a clearly matching recomputed wrapper
M1369 must evaluate source-diverse protected diagnostics
M1369 must run fresh public and moderate-OOD generalization comparisons
M1369 must run behavior and ablation retention seeds
M1369 must not train, run PPO, use private holdout, or promote
forbidden_shortcuts: do not relax thresholds after seeing failures
do not let a single legacy protected key veto a source-diverse pass
do not claim strong self-identification or paper-level source-rich extreme validation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M1362 alpha 0.1 candidate is eligible for a separate public-base promotion audit after exact, proof, fresh generalization, and behavior gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: promotion-gate candidate only; no actual promotion, PPO, private holdout, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the actor input contract changes
stop if exact source-history retention fails
stop if public proof replay or source-diverse diagnostics fail
stop if fresh public or moderate-OOD generalization regresses
stop if behavior or ablation retention regresses
fallback_plan: if contract fails, route to contract audit
if exact or proof replay fails, route to proof failure audit
if fresh generalization fails, route to generalization regression audit
if behavior fails, route to behavior regression audit
if all tiers pass, route to separate promotion audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1368 admits the public-base promotion/generalization gate implementation

admission_evidence: M1362 alpha 0.1 passes exact source-history and two-surface replay preflight
M1365 passes six public replay surfaces and behavior seeds
M1368 defines fresh generalization and promotion-gate criteria
allowed_updates: generic promotion/generalization gate tool if missing
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one follow-up manifest chosen by the result class
next_stage_criteria: result class is written to summary.json
candidate either routes to separate promotion audit or to a named failure audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1369 is a public-base promotion/generalization gate; it does not prove history necessity beyond existing wrong-history and ablation diagnostics.
history_necessity_tests: behavior ablations must retain normal >= reset >= zero-all ordering
wrong-history proof replay must be preserved, but this is not enough for level3 self-identification
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362 alpha 0.1 candidate compared against M1154 on exact source-history, public replay, fresh public, moderate-OOD, and behavior seeds.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If any tier fails, preserve the failing rows and route to an audit before repair; do not tune from private holdout.
allowed_claims: public-base promotion-gate candidacy if all tiers pass
no actual promotion, strong self-identification, private-holdout, high-fidelity, real-vehicle, or paper-level source-rich extreme claim

hypothesis: The M1362 alpha 0.1 checkpoint can pass a no-training public-base promotion/generalization gate against M1154 after its broad public replay pass.
success_criteria: public proof replay and source-diverse diagnostics are evaluated
fresh public and moderate-OOD generalization are evaluated
behavior and ablation retention seeds are evaluated
result class and failure taxonomy are written
no training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: public proof replay or source-diverse diagnostics fail
fresh public or moderate-OOD generalization regresses
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
